About Us

Our Story & Values

Est. 2020

Who We Are

Shakya Real Estate was established in 2020 with a simple mission: to provide honest, transparent, and results-driven real estate services to the people of Carramar and Western Sydney.

Serving a culturally diverse community, our multilingual team speaks your language — literally and figuratively. We understand the unique needs of Western Sydney's vibrant communities and are committed to delivering exceptional service in every transaction.

From first home buyers to seasoned investors, our team brings local expertise, market intelligence, and unwavering dedication to every client relationship. We believe property transactions are among the most important decisions in a person's life, and we treat each one with the care and professionalism it deserves.

Our office at 272 River Avenue, Carramar is always open to welcome you. Whether you're looking to buy, sell, rent or invest, our team is ready to guide you every step of the way.

About Sushil

Sushil Shakya is a passionate and dedicated real estate agent with a deep knowledge of the Carramar and Western Sydney property market. As an assistant real estate agent at Shakya Real Estate, Sushil brings enthusiasm, professionalism, and a genuine commitment to helping clients achieve their property goals.

Sushil specialises in residential sales, rentals, and buyer advocacy across the Fairfield LGA. His multilingual abilities allow him to serve the diverse Western Sydney community effectively, breaking down communication barriers that can make property transactions stressful. Sushil believes every client deserves clear, honest guidance throughout the entire process.

Growing up in Western Sydney, Sushil has an intimate understanding of the local communities, school catchments, transport links, and lifestyle amenities that matter most to buyers and tenants. This local insight, combined with his commitment to staying current with market trends, enables him to provide advice you can truly rely on.

Whether you're a first home buyer navigating the market for the first time, an investor building your portfolio, or a landlord seeking professional management of your rental property, Sushil is committed to delivering results that exceed your expectations. His honest, straightforward approach and tireless work ethic have earned him a reputation as a trusted property professional in the community.

About Michelle

Michelle Jones is the Principal and Senior Property Consultant at Shakya Real Estate, bringing over 15 years of professional real estate experience to our team. Her deep market knowledge, strategic approach to sales, and unwavering commitment to client outcomes have established her as one of Western Sydney's most respected property professionals.

As our team leader, Michelle specialises in residential sales and investment property, consistently achieving premium results for vendors through targeted marketing campaigns and skilled negotiation. Her extensive network of buyers and investors, built over more than a decade in the industry, provides sellers with a distinct advantage in any market condition.

Michelle is passionate about helping clients navigate the property market with confidence. Whether guiding first-time sellers through the process or advising experienced investors on portfolio strategy, she delivers personalised service backed by comprehensive market analysis and genuine care for client outcomes.

Her leadership of the Shakya Real Estate team reflects her belief that a strong agency is built on honesty, professionalism, and continuous improvement. Michelle mentors each team member to uphold the highest standards of client service, ensuring that every client who works with Shakya Real Estate receives an exceptional experience from first contact to settlement.
